name: due-diligence-report
description: Drafts legal due diligence reports for M&A and financing transactions, in red-flag and full-form versions, from a virtual data room: source-review register, findings matrix rated Critical, Significant, Moderate or Minor, consents table, and reconciliation of seller summaries to executed contracts and amendments. Checks the data room index and Q&A log before calling a document missing; tests change-of-control and anti-assignment clauses against the deal structure (stock purchase, reverse triangular merger, asset purchase); flags exclusivity, MFN and non-compete clauses binding the buyer's affiliates; reviews IP chain of title and open source, WARN Act aggregation, misclassification, litigation and regulatory exposure, UCC lien searches against the debt schedule, aggregated sub-threshold risk, and privilege and clean teams. Use for diligence report, red flag memo, legal due diligence, target review or data room review. Routes gun-jumping to hsr-filing and findings to disclosure-schedules and merger-agreement.
